name_zh: 奥斯兰德-布赫斯包姆定理
name_en: Auslander-Buchsbaum theorem (unique factorization in regular local rings)
canonical_name: Auslander-Buchsbaum unique-factorization theorem for regular local rings
literal_source_claim_en: A regular local ring is a unique factorization domain.
canonical_statement: Every commutative regular local ring is a unique factorization domain.
canonical_claim: For every commutative ring R, if R is a regular local ring, then R has unique factorization into irreducibles up to units.
